tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search active deals on HarbiFırsat (Turkish-aware: plurals, missing accents and small typos match). Optional filters: category slug, store slug, minimum discount %, maximum price (TRY).

tools.name: get_hot_deals
tools.description: Today's hottest deals on HarbiFırsat, ranked by community votes with time decay (like the site's front page).

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details of one deal by its slug (the last part of a harbifirsat.co/deals/<slug> URL).

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: All stores on HarbiFırsat with their number of active deals and store page URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All deal categories (name, slug, page URL).

tools.name: get_store_deals
tools.description: Newest active deals of one store, by store slug (see list_stores).

tools.name: get_latest_aktuel
tools.description: Latest weekly "aktüel" catalogs of Turkish grocery chains (BİM, A101, ŞOK, Migros, …). Without a brand: the newest catalog of every chain. With a brand slug: its last 5 catalogs. Each item links to the viewer.
